# BesideOS: full catalog

> Operating systems BesideOS can install beside the current one, without a USB stick. https://besideos.com/

## Ubuntu
- id: ubuntu
- family: linux
- tagline: Yeni başlayanlar için en yaygın Linux.
- best for: Linux'a ilk kez geçenler ve sorun olduğunda bol kaynak bulmak isteyenler.
- desktop: GNOME
- official download page: https://ubuntu.com/download/desktop
- page: https://besideos.com/#/distros/ubuntu
- ISO (x86_64): https://releases.ubuntu.com/26.04.1/ubuntu-26.04.1-desktop-amd64.iso (checksums: https://releases.ubuntu.com/26.04.1/SHA256SUMS)
- ISO (arm64): https://cdimage.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/releases/26.04.1/release/ubuntu-26.04.1-desktop-arm64.iso (checksums: https://cdimage.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/releases/26.04.1/release/SHA256SUMS)

- id: xubuntu

## Linux Mint
